text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~, I bought it!
The new instant cup noodles!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think I'll go ahead and dig in
at the dine-in corner right away♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
............
An eat-in area, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, on the first day, if I recall...—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Go raibh maith agat...
Likewise.
Thank you very much for your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh♪
I bought it, I actually managed to buy it...!
My very first purchase in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um, I believe there was an 'eat-in' space around here somewhere...
Would those seats over there be fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear? The person in charge of pouring hot water isn't coming...?
Could this not be the place to wait?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Excuse me, you over there!
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(That was when I met Trainer.
Even while tilting their head in confusion, they still helped me.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's just so easy to talk to.
So... yeah. Out of pure habit, I ended up asking.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kind stranger, thank you for guiding me♪
Now then, next—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you be so kind as
to escort me to Menya Goku Goku?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...So this is a real ramen shop...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(It seems when your heart throbs too intensely, everything goes quiet.
Faced with the one I admired, my feet felt light and weightless.
As you beckoned, I flusteredly hurried after you.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So this is the ticket vending machine!
May I try buying one?
Don't worry, I've already studied how it works!"
choice_data_list: You want to study the method...? Sure, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
...What should I do? Even though I decided on my order
in advance, I feel like I'm going to hesitate again!
choice_data_list: Now that we bought it... looks like those seats over there are open.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah... We're really close together...!
Is this okay? I feel like my shoulder's
going to bump into the person next to me...!
choice_data_list: Just say sorry and it'll be fine— you're worrying too much, it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! Thank goodness...!
Then don't mind if I do... Excuse me~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(And then, the ramen arrived.
After 43 days, the bowl I had been waiting for.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I got chopsticks from Trainer...
Hehe, maybe I was straining too hard.
I couldn't snap them cleanly down the middle.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the food!
............

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...*slip*.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Th-this is...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The garlic and the powerful, wild flavor...
hit my head like a ton of bricks! All at once!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Slurp it up, huh... All right...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —*Slurp!*

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
It worked! I actually made a sound...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Delicious... It's so delicious!
What do I do? It's disappearing so fast!
choice_data_list: Then we've got an extra serving of noodles right here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is where you ask for extra noodles!
All right, I'm gonna try ordering some~...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...E-Excuse meee!
Could I please get an extra serving of noodles?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that was so much fun.
What a wonderful adventure.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I took the plunge into an unfamiliar world on my own.
I wasn't used to it, and I was just copying what I saw, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I managed to dive right in.
I reached out and touched my dream with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I went on an adventure.
—With you as my escort, Trainer.
